summary: Verified news detail feature: /berita cards + landing 'Berita Terbaru' cards each have 'Baca Selengkapnya' link that opens /berita/:slug with title, category, date, summary, and full content section. Unknown slug shows safe 'Berita tidak ditemukan' state. Mobile viewport has no horizontal overflow. Super Admin CMS announcement content field saves via PUT /api/site/content and is reflected in GET; restored to original after test.

issues: Content textarea (line 195) has no data-testid; consider `announcement-content-{idx}` for testability

Seeded announcement uses category 'Jadwal' which is not in the sidebar category list (Semua/Pengumuman/Informasi/Kegiatan Program/...). It still shows under 'Semua Berita', but no dedicated filter matches.

action_items: Optional: add data-testid on the announcement content textarea for future UI tests
Optional: align seeded announcement category values with NewsPage category filter list (e.g., replace 'Jadwal' with a supported category or add 'Jadwal' to the filter)
critical_code_review_comments: Detail lookup relies on slugified title only; if two announcements share a slug the first match wins. Consider a stable id/slug field on announcements.
NewsDetailPage waits on GET /site/content and shows 'Berita tidak ditemukan' on load — no explicit loading skeleton; user briefly sees not-found state before data arrives. Consider a loading state.
NewsPage.jsx and NewsDetailPage.jsx duplicate the slugify function; extract to shared util.
